rationale: A third party (neighbor's child) suffered bodily injury on the policyholder's premises due to a hazardous condition (icy walkway), establishing premises liability.
claim_summary: Nine-year-old neighbor's child suffered a broken wrist after slipping on ice on the policyholder's front walkway during last week's ice storm. Parents are discussing medical bills. High-severity pediatric injury claim with $500,000 liability coverage available.

case_facts.location: Walkway in front of policyholder's house
case_facts.description: Child slipped and fell on icy walkway
